LATAM Accountant    Brazil | Remote      About Sycomp    Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.      About the Role      We are looking for a detail-oriented LATAM Accountant to support accounting operations across multiple countries in the region. description:
Confira a vaga para Service delivery representative em mogi das cruzes. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Make this the place where you grow!      Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação, desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e Service Now, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas,      Com operações em mais de 30 países e reunindo 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 países, permitimos que milhares de empresas se tornassem mais eficientes e eficazes nas últimas três décadas.    Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT.      Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede. Make this the place where you grow!      Estamos em busca de um(a) Service Delivery Representative para atuar na gestão dos serviços de suporte de TI de um cliente estratégico. Este profissional será responsável por garantir a qualidade da operação, coordenar equipes multidisciplinares, acompanhar indicadores de desempenho, assegurar o cumprimento dos SLAs contratados e promover a melhoria contínua dos processos de atendimento. Será o principal ponto de gestão operacional entre a equipe técnica e o cliente, atuando de forma proativa na identificação de riscos, definição de planos de ação e acompanhamento das entregas da operação.      Responsabilidades:     Gerenciar a operação de serviços de TI, garantindo a estabilidade e continuidade dos serviços prestados; Coordenar equipes de suporte técnico (N1, N2 e N3), distribuindo demandas e acompanhando a execução das atividades; Assegurar o cumprimento dos SLAs e KPIs estabelecidos contratualmente; Atuar como principal interface operacional junto ao cliente, conduzindo reuniões de acompanhamento e apresentações de resultados; Gerenciar incidentes críticos, problemas recorrentes e escalonamentos, garantindo rápida resolução; Elaborar e acompanhar planos de ação para melhoria contínua dos serviços; Monitorar indicadores operacionais, produtividade, qualidade e capacidade da equipe; Garantir a correta aplicação dos processos de Gestão de Incidentes, Problemas, Mudanças e Requisições; Identificar oportunidades de otimização de processos, automações e redução de custos operacionais; Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico e profissional da equipe, promovendo feedbacks e acompanhamento de desempenho; Elaborar relatórios executivos e dashboards gerenciais para apresentação ao cliente e à liderança. O atendimento desta vaga será para alocação em um único cliente, sendo responsável pela gestão operacional dos serviços de Suporte de TI.    Requisitos:     Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas; Experiência em gestão de operações de TI ou gestão de serviços de suporte; Sólida experiência em operações de AMS (Application Management Services); Experiência comprovada com suporte SAP HANA/SAP S/4 HANA; Vivência na gestão de equipes técnicas multidisciplinares; Experiência no acompanhamento e gestão de SLAs, KPIs e indicadores operacionais; Conhecimento das melhores práticas de ITIL; Experiência na condução de reuniões executivas com clientes; Capacidade de gerenciamento de incidentes críticos e gestão de crises; Conhecimento em ferramentas de ITSM (Service Now, SAP Solution Manager, Jira Service Management, BMC Remedy ou similares); Excelente comunicação, organização, capacidade analítica e perfil de liderança. title: Customer support specialist - brazil
description:
Confira a vaga para Customer support specialist - brazil em mogi das cruzes. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist      Who We Are:    Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.      Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.      You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk    or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.      Why this role matters:    Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.      Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.   Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.   Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.   Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.   Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard    What We’re Looking For:    Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.    Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a Saa S or B2 B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, Java Script) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

title: Investidor
description:
Confira a vaga para Investidor em boituva. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI    Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar    O Cenário Atual    Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

title: Senior google ads specialist
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior google ads specialist em capão da canoa. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Senior Google Ads Specialist (DTC E-commerce)      Talent Global LLC – Remote      About the Role      We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Google Ads Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts for a California-based furniture company. This role is focused on driving profitable growth through Google Ads, with a strong emphasis on Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce marketing of physical products .    The ideal candidate has a proven track record of scaling consumer brands through paid advertising, particularly within e-commerce environments, and is comfortable managing campaigns across multiple advertising platforms. While Google Ads expertise is the primary requirement, experience with Meta Ads and other paid media channels is highly valued.    This is a part-time remote position with the goal of transitioning into a full-time role as the business continues to grow.      Responsibilities      Google Ads Management Own and manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, and Remarketing. Develop, implement, and optimize campaign strategies to drive revenue growth and profitability. Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, bid management, and account structure optimization. Continuously optimize performance based on ROAS, CAC, MER, conversion rate, and revenue goals. Design and execute testing strategies for ad copy, landing pages, audiences, campaign structures, and bidding models. Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to scale efficiently. Manage advertising budgets and allocate spend based on performance insights. Ensure accurate conversion tracking, attribution, and reporting.    Multi-Channel Paid Media Manage and optimize Meta Ads campaigns when applicable. Identify opportunities across additional paid channels such as You Tube, Microsoft Ads, Pinterest, or Tik Tok. Develop cross-channel strategies that support customer acquisition and revenue growth.    Analytics & Reporting Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights. Build and maintain reporting dashboards and performance summaries. Collaborate with stakeholders to align advertising strategies with business objectives. Monitor attribution and customer journey data to improve campaign effectiveness.    Required Qualifications     8+ years of experience managing paid media campaigns. Extensive hands-on experience with Google Ads for DTC e-commerce brands. Proven success marketing physical consumer products through paid advertising.    Strong expertise in:   Google Search Ads Google Shopping Ads Performance Max Campaigns Remarketing & Audience Strategies Demonstrated experience scaling e-commerce brands while maintaining profitability. Deep understanding of key e-commerce metrics, including: ROAS CAC MER AOV Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, and attribution. Ability to work independently and make data-driven decisions.    Preferred Qualifications     Experience managing Meta Ads campaigns. Experience advertising furniture, home goods, lifestyle, consumer products, or other DTC brands. Experience working with Shopify. Experience with Google Merchant Center and product feed optimization. Familiarity with Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), landing page testing, and funnel optimization. SEO knowledge is a plus but not required.    Schedule      Part-Time (15–20 hours per week) Flexible schedule with the goal of transitioning to a full-time position.    Location: Fully remote.

title: Investidor
description:
Confira a vaga para Investidor em garibaldi. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI    Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar    O Cenário Atual    Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI    Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar    O Cenário Atual    Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior bussiness analyst - finance em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Who We Are We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive transformation. Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep industry knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses. Who We Are Looking For We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Finance , a client-facing lead role responsible for supporting complex HOIST projects and leading the implementation of finance-related ERP modules across different regional clients. This role acts as an escalation point for Business Analysts and Junior Business Analysts within the finance domain, providing functional expertise, guidance, and leadership throughout project delivery. The Senior Business Analyst – Finance will work closely with clients, stakeholders, Project Managers, Solutions Architects, development teams, and finance users to gather requirements, define solutions, support implementation, and ensure the successful adoption of financial processes and ERP functionalities. If you have strong IFS finance expertise, experience leading ERP implementation or upgrade projects, and enjoy working directly with clients to deliver high-impact financial business solutions, we encourage you to apply. Key Responsibilities • Lead the gathering, analysis, and definition of finance-related business requirements, ensuring alignment with client needs, financial processes, reporting requirements, and ERP capabilities. • Design, implement, test, and support finance-focused ERP solutions in collaboration with clients, stakeholders, Project Managers, Solutions Architects, development teams, and functional teams. • Provide guidance on finance best practices, ERP configuration, process optimization, compliance, financial controls, and system performance improvements. • Perform gap analysis and propose scalable solutions to improve financial workflows, system functionality, efficiency, accuracy, and user adoption. • Translate complex financial, functional, and technical concepts into clear information for non-technical stakeholders. • Act as an escalation point and provide guidance to Business Analysts and Junior Business Analysts within the finance domain. • Support project planning, estimation, risk management, design discussions, cross-functional communication, training, documentation, and issue resolution. • Maintain IFS finance expertise, stay updated on ERP and industry best practices, and act as a subject matter expert for finance processes, accounting workflows, and ERP functionality. What We Offer • Competitive salary and benefits package. • Career development opportunities with training and mentorship. • A collaborative, diverse, and global work environment. • Involvement in complex international ERP and IFS finance-focused projects. • Opportunities to act as a finance subject matter expert and contribute to business transformation initiatives. • Health and wellness benefits to support work-life balance. Why Hoist? If you are looking for an opportunity to make an impact and grow your career in a dynamic, global environment, Hoist is the place for you. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, flexibility, expertise, and professional growth.

title: Abm & b2b marketing specialist
description:
Nova oportunidade para Abm & b2b marketing specialist em viamão. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title: ABM & Revenue Operations Associate    Type: Part-time (with strong potential to scale to full-time)    Location: Remote    Schedule: Flexible, aligned with US working hours      About the Role    This is a hands-on execution role supporting Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and go-to-market systems for B2 B companies operating in niche markets.    You will work directly within a fractional consulting model, where strategy, execution, and iteration are tightly connected. There are no large teams or layered structures—only clear processes, defined systems, and a strong focus on impact.    The role is built for someone who can think analytically, execute independently, and contribute directly to pipeline generation through structured, high-quality work.      Role Overview    We are looking for someone who can operate across research, campaign execution, content production, and reporting.    This is not a coordination role. You will be responsible for building and running key parts of the system: from target account lists and outbound sequences to campaign briefs and performance analysis.    You will have context, tools, and autonomy—but also ownership over execution quality and outcomes.      Responsibilities    ABM & Go-To-Market Execution Build and maintain Target Account Lists based on ICP, intent signals, and segmentation logic Conduct account research: map buyer committees, identify pain points, triggers, and competitive context Develop outbound sequences (Email + Linked In), including copywriting, segmentation variants, QA, and iteration Create detailed campaign briefs: messaging per persona/tier, offer, CTA, required assets, and dependencies Manage deliverables across campaign cycles, ensuring continuity and documentation of outcomes  Content & Deliverables Produce strategy briefs, one-pagers, and sales-oriented summaries Create slides and lightweight mockups for campaigns or client-facing materials Build reusable templates (messaging frameworks, research structures, briefing formats)  Reporting & Analysis Track and report on activity and performance: engagement by account, sequence performance, pipeline progression Identify patterns across campaigns: messaging effectiveness, segment performance, conversion trends Document insights and integrate learnings into future campaign cycles    Qualifications    Must-Have Experience in B2 B marketing, sales, growth, or similar execution roles Strong analytical thinking applied to real business problems Excellent written and spoken English (clear, concise, and business-oriented) Ability to work independently Strong organizational and documentation skills Experience using AI tools (e.g., Chat GPT, Claude) as part of daily workflows Ability to produce high-quality work with speed and consistency  Nice-to-Have Familiarity with ABM or outbound strategies Experience with tools such as Hub Spot, Apollo, Clay, Linked In Sales Navigator Proficiency with Google Sheets or similar tools Experience with Canva or Figma for basic visual deliverables Familiarity with Notion, Click Up, or similar documentation/project tools      What We’re Looking For An execution-driven operator who can both think and do Someone comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving environment A clear communicator who writes with purpose and precision Highly autonomous, proactive, and accountable Detail-oriented, with strong standards for deliverables AI-fluent: able to leverage AI effectively while applying critical thinking and judgment

This role is focused on execution — editing high-performing ad creatives — not creative direction or broad AI production work. The client is scaling their in-house content team and is looking for editors who can move fast, follow briefs precisely, and contribute to a growing AI-driven workflow.      Key Responsibilities Edit short-form video ads for Meta, Tik Tok, and other paid social platforms Work from creative briefs to produce polished, on-brand ad creatives Edit performance marketing / DTC / e-commerce style content optimized for conversion, not just aesthetics Apply strong pacing, transitions, typography, and hooks suited for paid ad environments Use AI tools within the editing workflow and stay current on new AI-driven editing/production tools Share relevant AI workflows or tool discoveries with the broader creative team Complete assigned edits independently and hit deadlines in a fast-paced, iterative environment Collaborate with the creative/marketing team on revisions and performance-based iteration    Requirements Minimum 6 years of hands-on video editing experience Direct experience editing paid ad creatives for performance marketing, DTC, or e-commerce brands Strong command of editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Cap Cut, or similar) Comfortable using AI tools as part of an editing workflow (nice to have: exposure to Runway, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Pika, or similar) Ability to work full-time, aligned with US business hours Strong portfolio specifically showcasing paid social / ad creative editing (not just general video work)    Ideal Candidate    This person is an editor first — someone who thrives on turning a brief into a finished, high-performing ad creative rather than driving concept or direction. LATAM Accountant    Brazil | Remote      About Sycomp    Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries. title: Investidor
description:
Empresa está contratando Investidor em araquari. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI    Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar    O Cenário Atual    Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável? title: Investidor

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI    Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar    O Cenário Atual    Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

title: Investidor
description:
Confira a vaga para Investidor em passo fundo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI    Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar    O Cenário Atual    Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

Continuously optimize performance based on ROAS, CAC, MER, conversion rate, and revenue goals. Design and execute testing strategies for ad copy, landing pages, audiences, campaign structures, and bidding models. Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to scale efficiently. Manage advertising budgets and allocate spend based on performance insights. Ensure accurate conversion tracking, attribution, and reporting.    Multi-Channel Paid Media Manage and optimize Meta Ads campaigns when applicable. Identify opportunities across additional paid channels such as You Tube, Microsoft Ads, Pinterest, or Tik Tok. Develop cross-channel strategies that support customer acquisition and revenue growth.    Analytics & Reporting Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights. Build and maintain reporting dashboards and performance summaries. Collaborate with stakeholders to align advertising strategies with business objectives. Monitor attribution and customer journey data to improve campaign effectiveness.    Required Qualifications     8+ years of experience managing paid media campaigns. Strong expertise in:   Google Search Ads Google Shopping Ads Performance Max Campaigns Remarketing & Audience Strategies Demonstrated experience scaling e-commerce brands while maintaining profitability. Preferred Qualifications     Experience managing Meta Ads campaigns. Experience advertising furniture, home goods, lifestyle, consumer products, or other DTC brands. Experience working with Shopify. A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. description:
Nova oportunidade para Legal analyst em araquari. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Legal Analyst      Description    We are seeking an experienced Legal Analyst to support a growing U. S.-based law firm specializing in commercial transactions and corporate legal matters. This 100% remote position will work directly with attorneys to draft, review, and negotiate a wide variety of legal agreements while assisting with corporate governance, due diligence, legal research, and select mergers and acquisitions (M& A) matters.      The ideal candidate is highly organized, fluent in English (written and spoken), experienced supporting U. S.-based attorneys or businesses, and comfortable managing multiple legal projects simultaneously with minimal supervision.      Responsibilities Draft, review, edit, and redline commercial agreements, including Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), service agreements, purchase agreements, and amendments. Prepare first drafts of legal documents using attorney guidance and firm templates. Conduct legal research related to commercial, corporate, contract, and business law matters. Assist attorneys with corporate governance matters, entity formations, annual filings, and corporate record maintenance. Support mergers and acquisitions activities, including due diligence, document organization, disclosure schedules, and transaction closing checklists. Review contracts for legal, commercial, and business risks and summarize key issues for attorney review. Coordinate contract execution, signature collection, and final document management. Maintain organized electronic legal files and document management systems. Track transaction timelines, deadlines, and attorney action items across multiple client matters. Assist with client correspondence and preparation of legal deliverables. Support process improvements and standardization of legal templates and document workflows.    Requirements Education & Licensure: Law Degree (LL. B., J. D., or regional equivalent) from an accredited law school. Active bar admission/license to practice law from Brazil, or a relevant international jurisdiction is strictly required. Experience: 5–10 years of post-qualification experience (PQE) practicing corporate law, either within a reputable law firm or as in-house counsel. M& A Expertise: Proven track record of actively working on M& A transactions and drafting/negotiating complex purchase agreements. Language: Native or bilingual fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory, with the ability to draft complex legal documents in English. U. S. Context: Deep experience supporting U. S.-based companies, cross-border transactions, or working under common law principles. Negotiation Skills: Strong commercial acumen with a proven ability to redline contracts effectively and negotiate directly with opposing counsel.    Technical Requirements Document Management: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word (specifically tracking changes and document comparison), Excel, and Google Workspace. Legal Tech: Experience utilizing Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms (e.g., Ironclad, Docu Sign, Contract Works) and digital signature workflows. Collaboration: Comfortable operating in agile, remote environments using tools like Teams, Slack, and Zoom. Innovation: Experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., Chat GPT, specialized legal AI) to drive legal operations efficiency and streamline workflows.

title: Customer support specialist - brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Customer support specialist - brazil em suzano. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist      Who We Are:    Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.      Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.      You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk    or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.      Why this role matters:    Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.      Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.   Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.   Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.   Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.   Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard    What We’re Looking For:    Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.    Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a Saa S or B2 B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, Java Script) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

description:

Video Editor (Paid Ads / Performance Content)    Talent Global LLC — Latin America (Remote)    Full-Time (40 hrs/week) | US Time Zones | Long-Term Contract      About the Role    Our client (a US-based Creative Agency/Venture Studio) is looking for a hands-on Video Editor with strong experience creating paid ads content for social platforms. This role is focused on execution — editing high-performing ad creatives — not creative direction or broad AI production work. The client is scaling their in-house content team and is looking for editors who can move fast, follow briefs precisely, and contribute to a growing AI-driven workflow. title: Customer support specialist - brazil
description:
Confira a vaga para Customer support specialist - brazil em são josé dos campos. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist      Who We Are:    Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.      Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.      You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk    or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.      Why this role matters:    Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.      Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.   Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.   Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.   Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.   Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard    What We’re Looking For:    Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. structures, briefing formats)  Reporting & Analysis Track and report on activity and performance: engagement by account, sequence performance, pipeline progression Identify patterns across campaigns: messaging effectiveness, segment performance, conversion trends Document insights and integrate learnings into future campaign cycles    Qualifications    Must-Have Experience in B2 B marketing, independently Strong organizational and documentation skills Experience using AI tools (e.g., Chat GPT, Claude) as part of daily workflows Ability to produce high-quality work with speed and consistency  Nice-to-Have Familiarity with ABM or outbound strategies Experience with tools such as Hub Spot, Apollo, Clay, Linked In Sales Navigator Proficiency with Google Sheets or similar tools Experience with Canva or Figma for basic visual deliverables Familiarity with Notion, Click Up, or similar documentation/project tools      What We’re Looking For An execution-driven operator who can both think and do Someone comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving environment A clear communicator who writes with purpose and precision Highly autonomous, proactive, and accountable Detail-oriented, with strong standards for deliverables AI-fluent: able to leverage AI effectively while applying critical thinking and judgment

The role defines the operating model, drives day-to-day service quality, and partners closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to deliver a unified, high-quality support experience to enterprise and mid-market customers alike. Lead and develop the global support team across first, second, and advanced technical support and grow the function in line with portfolio growth. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

title: Global head of customer support
description:
Empresa está contratando Global head of customer support em montenegro. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Our client, a global leader in in food safety, compliance, and product integrity solutions, is seeking a Head of Customer Support. This role leads the strategy, performance, and customer experience of the global software support function within the Digital Solutions division. This leader is responsible for a distributed support team providing first, second, and advanced technical support across the division’s software portfolio. The role defines the operating model, drives day-to-day service quality, and partners closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to deliver a unified, high-quality support experience to enterprise and mid-market customers alike. Will be working to support customers in over 100 countries and supporting product teams in the US, LATAM, EMEA , and APAC.      Key Responsibilities: Define and execute the customer support strategy, operating model, and service frameworks aligned to ITIL best practices and division objectives. Lead and develop the global support team across first, second, and advanced technical support and grow the function in line with portfolio growth. Own end-to-end service delivery: including incident, problem, and change management Establish, monitor, and report on the KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS measures that govern support performance Provide oversight on complex technical escalations, root cause analysis, and cross-functional resolution across cloud and on-premise environments. Partner with Product Management and Engineering on defect lifecycle, prioritisation, customer communication, and feeding service insights back into the product roadmap. Own the support customer experience, including service reviews, senior escalations, key-account relationships, and the onboarding and adoption experience for new customers. Build the knowledge management, self-service, and customer-facing documentation capabilities required to scale the function efficiently. Lead adoption of automation, analytics, and AI-driven tooling; including Fresh Service and equivalent service management platforms Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing support organization Provide regular reporting and insight to division leadership on support performance, customer risk, retention impact, and investment priorities. Support the integration of newly acquired products into the support operating model as the portfolio evolves.    Required Qualifications: Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in customer support or technical support, with at least 3 years leading distributed support teams within Saa S or software businesses. Experience managing managers or team leads, and growing a support function over time. Working knowledge of ITIL, support methodologies, and service management best practices, including incident, problem, and change management. Strong technical acumen across Saa S architectures, cloud environments (AWS and Microsoft Azure), web technologies, and relational databases Track record managing the support relationship with Product and Engineering, including defect lifecycle, prioritisation, and roadmap influence. Data-driven approach with hands-on experience using support KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS to drive measurable performance improvement. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and key customers. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience. Must be bilingual English and Portuguese.    Preferred Qualifications: Experience leading support integration during mergers and acquisitions or multi-product portfolio consolidation. Familiarity with Fresh Service or equivalent enterprise service management platforms. Experience implementing AI-assisted support, self-service deflection, and proactive monitoring capabilities at scale. Background supporting customers in regulated industries (food, life sciences, manufacturing, or comparable).    This is a CLT role R$40-50 K/month. Role is remote but some travel may be required. Both domestic and international.

title: Virtual assistant
description:
Nova oportunidade para Virtual assistant em toledo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

We’re looking for full-time Virtual Assistants based in Brazil to join our global property management and real estate rental operations team. This is a fast-paced, service-driven role where you’ll communicate directly with guests and tenants across multiple properties, ensuring every experience meets our standard of excellence.      If you’re fluent in English, tech-savvy, and passionate about delivering outstanding customer service — this is a great opportunity to grow in an international environment.     ⸻      Key Responsibilities     • Craft clear, professional, and empathetic English responses to guest messages, emails, and inquiries across Airbnb, VRBO and other internal platforms.   • Maintain a 5 minute response time to all messages during your shift.   • Deescalate and resolve guest complaints with professionalism, empathy, and sound judgment.   • Coordinate with cleaning, maintenance, and operations teams to fulfill requests.   • Update and monitor internal systems, CRMs, and property dashboards.   • Document all customer interactions accurately for team follow-up and quality control.   • Collaborate with team members to ensure seamless daily operations.     ⸻      Requirements     • Fluent in English (spoken and written) – excellent grammar and communication tone.   • Strong typing skills (80+ WPM) and confidence navigating multiple platforms.   • High attention to detail, accountability, and ability to multitask under pressure.   • Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.   • Must have a reliable laptop/computer and high-speed Wi Fi.   • Previous experience with Airbnb, property management, or hospitality support is a plus but not required.   • Professional, positive, and culturally aligned with a high standard of service.     ⸻      Why Join Us     • Work 100% remotely from anywhere in Brazil.   • Full-time, consistent hours (40 hours/week).   • Competitive hourly rate in USD.   • Supportive, fast-growing international team.   • Career growth opportunities for high-performing team members.     ⸻      If you’re ready to join a professional, global team that values reliability, communication, and excellence — we’d love to meet you.

title: Investidor
description:
Nova oportunidade para Investidor em francisco beltrão. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI    Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar    O Cenário Atual    Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes.    O Problema do Mercado    Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo.    A Solução Yummi    A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login.    Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento    O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas.    Destinação do Capital e Custos Base    Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável.    Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável?   Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

title: Customer support specialist - brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para Customer support specialist - brazil em bauru. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist      Who We Are:    Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.      Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.      You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk    or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.      Why this role matters:    Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.      Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.   Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.   Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.   Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.   Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard    What We’re Looking For:    Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.    Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a Saa S or B2 B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, Java Script) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

description:

Job Title: ABM & Revenue Operations Associate    Type: Part-time (with strong potential to scale to full-time)    Location: Remote    Schedule: Flexible, aligned with US working hours      About the Role    This is a hands-on execution role supporting Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and go-to-market systems for B2 B companies operating in niche markets.    You will work directly within a fractional consulting model, where strategy, execution, and iteration are tightly connected. There are no large teams or layered structures—only clear processes, defined systems, and a strong focus on impact.    The role is built for someone who can think analytically, execute independently, and contribute directly to pipeline generation through structured, high-quality work.      Role Overview    We are looking for someone who can operate across research, campaign execution, content production, and reporting.    This is not a coordination role. You will be responsible for building and running key parts of the system: from target account lists and outbound sequences to campaign briefs and performance analysis.    You will have context, tools, and autonomy—but also ownership over execution quality and outcomes.      Responsibilities    ABM & Go-To-Market Execution Build and maintain Target Account Lists based on ICP, intent signals, and segmentation logic Conduct account research: map buyer committees, identify pain points, triggers, and competitive context Develop outbound sequences (Email + Linked In), including copywriting, segmentation variants, QA, and iteration Create detailed campaign briefs: messaging per persona/tier, offer, CTA, required assets, and dependencies Manage deliverables across campaign cycles, ensuring continuity and documentation of outcomes  Content & Deliverables Produce strategy briefs, one-pagers, and sales-oriented summaries Create slides and lightweight mockups for campaigns or client-facing materials Build reusable templates (messaging frameworks, research structures, briefing formats)  Reporting & Analysis Track and report on activity and performance: engagement by account, sequence performance, pipeline progression Identify patterns across campaigns: messaging effectiveness, segment performance, conversion trends Document insights and integrate learnings into future campaign cycles    Qualifications    Must-Have Experience in B2 B marketing, sales, growth, or similar execution roles Strong analytical thinking applied to real business problems Excellent written and spoken English (clear, concise, and business-oriented) Ability to work independently Strong organizational and documentation skills Experience using AI tools (e.g., Chat GPT, Claude) as part of daily workflows Ability to produce high-quality work with speed and consistency  Nice-to-Have Familiarity with ABM or outbound strategies Experience with tools such as Hub Spot, Apollo, Clay, Linked In Sales Navigator Proficiency with Google Sheets or similar tools Experience with Canva or Figma for basic visual deliverables Familiarity with Notion, Click Up, or similar documentation/project tools      What We’re Looking For An execution-driven operator who can both think and do Someone comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving environment A clear communicator who writes with purpose and precision Highly autonomous, proactive, and accountable Detail-oriented, with strong standards for deliverables AI-fluent: able to leverage AI effectively while applying critical thinking and judgment

Familiarity with Fresh Service or equivalent enterprise service management platforms. Background supporting customers in regulated industries (food, life sciences, manufacturing, or comparable).    This is a CLT role R$40-50 K/month. Role is remote but some travel may be required. Both domestic and international.
